newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent falls, eyes products for direction.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent falls, eyes products for direction.

text.p: SIMEX Brent futures fell by late afternoon dealings, pulling back the throttle on this week's rally amid a build in U.S. distillate stocks.
November Brent was down 16 cents at $24.42 per barrel compared with London's settlement of $24.58. December was down 12 cents at $23.99 from London's $24.11.
Brokers said the market eased on a 1.3 million barrel rise in U.S. distillate stocks reported late Tuesday by the American Petroleum Institute.
London gas oil futures were also weaker, undermining sentiment.
However, support was expected from the 810,000 barrel decline in U.S. gasoline stocks. In addition, distillate stocks remain well below previous year levels, brokers said.
Crude stocks were expected around one million barrels higher, but were almost 800,000 barrels down.

NYMEX November crude was bid on the after-hours ACCESS system at $25.36 per barrel, after rising 30 cents in New York to $25.54 and hitting an intraday high of $25.60 -- 10 cents short of the post Gulf War high.
